candidate.source_input: Okay so we are planning the weekend grocery run. Total budget is strictly under fifty dollars for everything. We already have plenty of pasta sauce at home, but we are completely out of olive oil. Mark noted he really prefers the organic apples if they have them, otherwise just regular ones are fine. I grabbed two bags of coffee beans yesterday using the store coupon, and today I picked up a carton of oat milk. The gourmet cheese block is totally optional, only get it if the total is still looking low. We need to check if we still have enough paper towels before buying more.
